services.name: Half Day Nearshore Fishing - Carolina Style
services.desc: Nearshore Fishing Charter 4 Hours About Carolina Style Sportfishing specializes in both inshore and offshore guided fishing charters from Wanchese, North Carolina located on the Outer Banks. We are #1 among all Outer Banks Fishing Charters for your family vacation in Outer Banks. Outer Banks is perfectly situated between the Atlantic Ocean and the Pamlico Sound. Along the western side of the Outer Banks lies the bountiful and protected Pamlico Sound. To the east lies the blue Atlantic Ocean. Our Outer Banks charter boat fishes for Tuna, Wahoo, Mahi-Mahi (Dorado aka Dolphin) and more. 4 Hours • All Ages • 6 Passengers Max • Private Charter

services.name: All Day Offshore Fishing - No Sweat
services.desc: Offshore Fishing Charter 11 Hours The Captain “What can I say about myself I can say that as a kid when other kids were mowing grass I was asked to be a 2nd mate on my dad’s 50 ft charter boat. After most of my teenage years fishing I figured out that you could not fall in love with the ocean so I left fishing. After my son was out of college I return to the Sea again mated for my father 15 years ago five years ago I got my captain’s license 3 years ago I begin leading people to the fish I am the 5th generation captain and my family has history of catching fish. My name is Doug 11 Hours • All Ages • 6 Passengers Max • Private Charter

services.name: All Day Offshore Fishing - Phideaux
services.desc: Offshore Fishing Charter 11 Hours About Phideaux Fishing on Roanoke Island is one of the only Outer Banks charter fishing operations to offer year-round service. If you’re looking to go offshore in the thick of winter, Captain Jamie Reibel is the one to call. He and brother Jeff Reibel fish full-time for a living — they don't stop after the warm season to move on to something else. Accordingly, their expertise is off the charts, and their system perfected. Phideaux Fishing offers full and half-day offshore and inshore charters, as well as bottom fishing trips and sunset fishing 11 Hours • All Ages • 6 Passengers Max • Private Charter

blurb: Located in Wanchese on Roanoke Island we are a short drive from downtown Manteo. Harbor Star offers guided tours blending adventure, education and stunning coastal scenery. Spot dolphins in their natural habitat, enjoy an eco-friendly excursion, and learn fascinating history about the Outer Banks and Roanoke Island. If you have never seen an Outer Banks sunset on the water, you are missing out!
